name: The Hermit Tanner

angles.text: Across the Barrens, you can help traders like Vrang carry goods over the rugged savanna.

faq.answer: Vrang sends you with a bundle of raw hides for his trading partner on the ridge above the Dry Hills.
faq.q: Who sends you on this delivery?

faq.answer: The hermit tanner lives alone on a secluded homestead atop a ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
faq.q: Where does the hermit tanner live?

faq.answer: Vrang warns you that the tanner's unusual appearance may startle you, but assures you that he poses no danger to visitors.
faq.q: Why does Vrang warn you about the tanner's appearance?

faq.answer: The steep, rocky climb is too taxing for Vrang to manage, so he asks a passing traveler to carry the hides.
faq.q: Why couldn't Vrang make the climb himself?

faq.answer: You carry a bundle of raw hides for the hermit's tanning trade, which he and Vrang share.
faq.q: What items are being delivered to the ridge?

aliases: what does tanner want with vrang
faq.answer: The hermit regrets that Vrang could not come in person and says he has something to discuss with him.
faq.q: What does the hermit tanner wish to discuss with Vrang?

sections.body: Across the Barrens, Vrang trades with a tanner who lives on a ridge above the Dry Hills. The steep, rocky climb is too hard for Vrang, so he asks passing travelers to carry raw hides to his partner's homestead.
sections.title: A Ridge in the Barrens

sections.body: Vrang warns you that the solitary tanner's unusual appearance may startle you, but says he is no danger to visitors. When you bring the hides to the ridge, the hermit welcomes you warmly. He regrets that Vrang could not come himself, for there is something he hoped to discuss with the trader.
sections.title: An Unconventional Craftsman

summary: You carry raw hides across the Barrens to The Hermit Tanner, who lives above the Dry Hills. Vrang cannot make the climb, so he sends you to his secluded trading partner.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Hermit Tanner
